REBEL RANCH MINISTRIES

FAITH  ·  FAMILY  ·  FREEDOM

You're doing everything right — and it still isn't working.
You want better food — but don't trust what's out there.
You want your kids prepared — but not indoctrinated.
You want community — but everything feels transactional.

Join the Community Explore Programs Partner With Us
The Ecosystem

One Mission.
Six Paths.

We didn't build one program. We built an ecosystem — every piece connected, every entity with a purpose, all of it pointed at the same thing: a better life for your family and a better world for the next generation.

501(c)(3) · Public

Faith, Family & Nature Church

The foundation. Our public-facing church — the spiritual anchor, the front door, and the grant-eligible umbrella that covers the whole mission.

508 · Private Ministry

Rebel Ranch Ministries

The application of faith. Where the programs live and the real work happens — with more privacy and the freedom to operate by conviction, not compliance.

PMA · Private Members

Rebel Ranch Marketplace

A private membership community built around real food, honest trade, and economic freedom. Raw milk. Farm animals. Barter. Exchange. By application only.

Education · Affiliated Entity

Rebel Ranch Academy

Trades. Homesteading. Business. Finance. Real skills for real life — taught by people who've actually done it. Because the world doesn't need more degrees. It needs capable people.

Under the Academy

Creation Station

For kids with hobbies that could become livelihoods, and crafters ready to turn passion into income. We invest in what they love — and teach them to make it last.

Community Service

Food Pantry

Real food from real farms going to real people who need it. Not government food. Not processed donations. Food from our community, for our community.

Faith, Family & Nature Church, Inc.

The Foundation

FFN Church is not a building you visit once a week. It is who we are — 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year. We are family. We are nature. We are freedom. Our church happens in conversation, in the field, around the fire, in the moments life hands us. School is always in session. So is the church.

  • Community that shows up — not just on Sundays
  • Real conversations, real answers, on demand
  • Auxiliary program for like-minded organizations
  • Food pantry and community support programs
  • Tax-deductible donation eligibility
  • Grant-funded community programs
  • A tribe of people who actually give a damn

Rebel Ranch Academy

Learn Skills.
Build a Life.

One hundred years ago nobody worked a 40-hour week for a corporation. People built things, grew things, traded things, and took care of their own. We got away from that. Rebel Ranch Academy exists to bring it back — real skills, real independence, real life.

🔨

Skilled Trades

Hands-on instruction in real trades — the kind of skills that can't be outsourced, automated, or taken from you. Work that pays for life.

Enrolling Now

Creation Station

Kids Who Create.
Adults Who Thrive.

Every kid has something they love. Most of the world tells them it's just a hobby. We say it's the beginning of a business — and we're going to help them prove it.

For Kids · Summer & Year-Round

Young Creators

These kids are capable. What's missing is this: nobody is teaching them how the world actually works. How to provide for themselves. How to build something. A hundred years ago, self-reliance wasn't a lifestyle choice — it was just life. We are bringing that back.

  • Discover and develop their craft or hobby
  • Learn basic business and money concepts
  • Create products or services to sell
  • Set up their first business with our support
  • Understand savings, pricing, and value
  • Build confidence through real accomplishment
Register Your Child

Rebel Ranch Marketplace · Private Membership Association

A Different Kind
of Marketplace

Do you know what is actually in your food? Pesticides. Lab-engineered ingredients. Chemicals approved by the same agencies paid to approve them. The commercial food system was not built to feed you — it was built to profit from you. The Rebel Ranch Marketplace exists outside that system. Real food from people you know. Honest trade. Fair exchange. Private membership means our producers keep more of their money, set their own terms, and answer to their community — not a corporation. If you are done trusting a label and ready to trust a neighbor — this was built for you.

Real Food AccessRaw milk, farm-fresh eggs, pasture-raised meats, and homegrown produce — direct from our partner farms.
Barter & TradeExchange goods and services within a community that values what you bring to the table — not just what you can buy.
Economic FreedomPrivate exchange within a member community — operating outside the limitations of the commercial marketplace.
Keep More MoneyProducers set their own prices, their own terms, their own payment plans. Less regulation. More freedom. More yours.
Apply for Membership

Membership is by application and approval. The Rebel Ranch Marketplace operates as a Private Membership Association. Not all goods and services are available to the general public.

Rebel Ranch Property · Trenton, FL

Unplug.
Come Home.

North Florida pine flatwoods. Gravel roads that disappear into the trees. Mornings with no agenda. We're building something real out here — camping, outdoor experiences, and a place to breathe.

Our property is currently under development. We're building it right — and when it's ready, you'll want to be the first to know.

COMING LATE 2026 · WE'LL REACH OUT PERSONALLY

Partner With Us

You Do the Work.
We Cover You.

We are looking for people already doing the work — farmers, tradespeople, teachers, crafters, community builders — who want more reach, more resources, and the institutional backing to do it bigger. We call them auxiliaries. And we want you.

We are not coming with a clipboard and a pitch. We are coming with a real offer: 501(c)(3) cover, strategic partnership, and access to everything we have built — in exchange for what you bring to the table. Everything on the table. Nothing hidden.

Why We Do This

Our board operates with zero salary. Every person building this is a volunteer. We did that on purpose — money should never contaminate a mission this important. This is not a get-rich scheme. This is not a nonprofit that pays its executives six figures while the community gets scraps.

We are here for the long game. We genuinely believe the more you give the more you get — and we are betting everything on that being true. Every dollar that comes in goes back into building something real for real people.

We know people are put off by organizations. We know trust is hard to come by right now. We just want you to know — some things are still pure. Some people still mean what they say. Find your tribe. We might be it.

Farms & Food Producers

Bring your products, your knowledge, and your community. We bring the institutional cover, the grant access, and the audience. Your donations become tax-deductible — day one.

The Ecosystem

One Mission.
Six Paths.

We didn't build one program. We built an ecosystem — every piece connected, every entity with a purpose, all of it pointed at the same thing: a better life for your family and a better world for the next generation.

501(c)(3) · Public

Faith, Family & Nature Church

The foundation. Our public-facing church — the spiritual anchor, the front door, and the grant-eligible umbrella that covers the whole mission.

508 · Private Ministry

Rebel Ranch Ministries

The application of faith. Where the programs live and the real work happens — with more privacy and the freedom to operate by conviction, not compliance.

PMA · Private Members

Rebel Ranch Marketplace

A private membership community built around real food, honest trade, and economic freedom. Raw milk. Farm animals. Barter. Exchange. By application only.

Trades. Homesteading. Business. Finance. Real skills for real life — taught by people who've actually done it. Because the world doesn't need more degrees. It needs capable people.

Community Service

Food Pantry

Real food from real farms going to real people who need it. Not government food. Not processed donations. Food from our community, for our community.

Faith, Family & Nature Church, Inc.

The Foundation

FFN Church is our public face — a 501(c)(3) church centered on faith, truth, natural law, and personal responsibility. We are not a Sunday-only church. We are a living, breathing community built for families who want their faith to mean something every day of the week.

  • Sunday gatherings rooted in scripture and natural law
  • Pastoral support and community covering
  • Auxiliary program for like-minded organizations
  • Charitable programs including food pantry
  • Tax-deductible donation eligibility
  • Grant-funded community programs
  • Faith-based family support services

Creation Station

Kids Who Create.
Adults Who Thrive.

Every kid has something they love. Most of the world tells them it's just a hobby. We say it's the beginning of a business — and we're going to help them prove it.

For Kids · Summer & Year-Round

Young Creators

We invest in what your child loves — and teach them to turn it into something that takes care of them. This summer, instead of screens and boredom, your kids get a future.

  • Discover and develop their craft or hobby
  • Learn basic business and money concepts
  • Create products, services, or skills to sell
  • Set up their first "business" with our support
  • Understand savings, pricing, and value
  • Build confidence through accomplishment
Register Your Child
For Crafters & Makers · All Ages

Creator Launch

You've got the talent. Maybe you just need the structure, the strategy, or the platform. We help crafters and makers turn what they love into what they live on.

  • Launch or grow your craft business
  • Pricing, branding, and market strategy
  • Sell at Rebel Ranch events and market
  • Host a workshop or teach a class here
  • Access the Marketplace community
  • Business and finance guidance included
Apply to the Creator Program

"We are raising a generation that doesn't know how to do anything — or pay for anything — on their own. Creation Station exists to fix that, one kid at a time."

Rebel Ranch Marketplace · Private Membership Association

A Different Kind
of Marketplace

The Rebel Ranch Marketplace is not a store. It is a private membership community built around fair exchange, real food, and economic freedom. Members gain access to goods, services, and opportunities that simply don't exist in the traditional marketplace. If you value food sovereignty, honest trade, and community-first economics — this was built for you.

Real Food Access Raw milk, farm-fresh eggs, pasture-raised meats, and homegrown produce — direct from our partner farms.
Barter & Trade Exchange goods and services within a community that values what you bring to the table — not just what you can buy.
Economic Freedom Private exchange within a member community — operating outside the limitations of the commercial marketplace.
Community Network Connect with farmers, tradespeople, crafters, and families who share your values and your vision.
Apply for Membership

Membership is by application and approval. The Rebel Ranch Marketplace operates as a Private Membership Association. Not all goods and services are available to the general public.

Rebel Ranch Property · Trenton, FL

Unplug.
Come Home.

North Florida pine flatwoods. Gravel roads that disappear into the trees. Mornings with no agenda. We're building something real out here — camping, outdoor experiences, and a place to breathe.

Our property is currently under development. We're building it right — and when it's ready, you'll want to be the first to know.

COMING 2025 · NO SPAM EVER

Partner With Us

You Do the Work.
We Cover You.

We are looking for people already doing the work — farmers, tradespeople, teachers, crafters, community builders — who want more reach, more resources, and the institutional backing to do it bigger. We call them auxiliaries. And we want you.

We're not coming with a clipboard and a pitch. We're coming with a real offer: 501(c)(3) cover, strategic partnership, and access to everything we've built — in exchange for what you bring to the table. Everything is on the table. Nothing is hidden.

Farms & Food Producers

Bring your products, your knowledge, and your community. We bring the institutional cover, the grant access, and the audience. Your donations become tax-deductible — day one.

Apply as Farm Partner

Tradespeople & Instructors

Welding, construction, electrical, plumbing, mechanics — if you can teach it, we want to platform it. Teach a class, earn an income, change a kid's life.

Businesses & Organizations

Align your brand with a mission that means something. Sponsor a program, partner on an event, or become a named auxiliary of Faith, Family & Nature Church.

Corporate Partnership

Community Leaders & Builders

Already running a program? Already building something? Come under the umbrella. Get covered, get resourced, and keep doing what you do — just bigger.

Faith, Family & Nature Church, Inc.

The Foundation

FFN Church is our public face — a 501(c)(3) church centered on faith, truth, natural law, and personal responsibility. We are not a Sunday-only church. We are a living, breathing community built for families who want their faith to mean something every day of the week.

  • Sunday gatherings rooted in scripture and natural law
  • Pastoral support and community covering
  • Auxiliary program for like-minded organizations
  • Charitable programs including food pantry
  • Tax-deductible donation eligibility
  • Grant-funded community programs
  • Faith-based family support services

Creation Station

Kids Who Create.
Adults Who Thrive.

Every kid has something they love. Most of the world tells them it's just a hobby. We say it's the beginning of a business — and we're going to help them prove it.

For Kids · Summer & Year-Round

Young Creators

We invest in what your child loves — and teach them to turn it into something that takes care of them. This summer, instead of screens and boredom, your kids get a future.

  • Discover and develop their craft or hobby
  • Learn basic business and money concepts
  • Create products, services, or skills to sell
  • Set up their first "business" with our support
  • Understand savings, pricing, and value
  • Build confidence through accomplishment
Register Your Child

Creator Launch

  • Launch or grow your craft business
  • Pricing, branding, and market strategy

Rebel Ranch Marketplace · Private Membership Association

A Different Kind
of Marketplace

The Rebel Ranch Marketplace is not a store. It is a private membership community built around fair exchange, real food, and economic freedom. Members gain access to goods, services, and opportunities that simply don't exist in the traditional marketplace. If you value food sovereignty, honest trade, and community-first economics — this was built for you.

Real Food Access Raw milk, farm-fresh eggs, pasture-raised meats, and homegrown produce — direct from our partner farms.
Barter & Trade Exchange goods and services within a community that values what you bring to the table — not just what you can buy.
Economic Freedom Private exchange within a member community — operating outside the limitations of the commercial marketplace.
Community Network Connect with farmers, tradespeople, crafters, and families who share your values and your vision.
Apply for Membership

Membership is by application and approval. The Rebel Ranch Marketplace operates as a Private Membership Association. Not all goods and services are available to the general public.

Rebel Ranch Property · Trenton, FL

Unplug.
Come Home.

North Florida pine flatwoods. Gravel roads that disappear into the trees. Mornings with no agenda. We're building something real out here — camping, outdoor experiences, and a place to breathe.

Our property is currently under development. We're building it right — and when it's ready, you'll want to be the first to know.

COMING 2025 · NO SPAM EVER

Partner With Us

You Do the Work.
We Cover You.

We are looking for people already doing the work — farmers, tradespeople, teachers, crafters, community builders — who want more reach, more resources, and the institutional backing to do it bigger. We call them auxiliaries. And we want you.

We're not coming with a clipboard and a pitch. We're coming with a real offer: 501(c)(3) cover, strategic partnership, and access to everything we've built — in exchange for what you bring to the table. Everything is on the table. Nothing is hidden.

Farms & Food Producers

Bring your products, your knowledge, and your community. We bring the institutional cover, the grant access, and the audience. Your donations become tax-deductible — day one.
